swipe.headline: Shapes that unlock what's underneath
swipe.subtext: Shapes designed to read you. Your profile is already forming.
swipe.hint: Pick the shape that feels like you

images.label: Wound up
images.form: A coil compressed tight, its turns pressed hard together, loaded and leaning off vertical — held energy with nowhere yet to go.

images.label: Settled
images.form: A soft mass slumped at rest, low and wide, spread by its own weight with its edges relaxed outward — nothing left to brace against.

images.label: Scattered
images.form: One form broken into fragments drifting apart, clear gaps of empty ground opening between the pieces — still recognisably one thing.

images.label: Lit up
images.form: A form with a bright teal core glowing out through fine cracks in its surface — the light coming from inside the volume, not falling on it.

images.label: A spark
images.form: A sharp bright tip rising off a low base, the whole form narrowing to the one lit point where it is about to catch.

images.label: Solid ground
images.form: A wide rooted base flaring where it meets the ground, carrying its mass squarely, planted and immovable.

images.label: A warm current
images.form: A soft wave drawn through a narrow gap between two forms, warming as it passes and touching both sides on the way.

images.label: The way through
images.form: A lit opening cut in a thick wall, the light falling forward through it onto the ground beyond.

images.label: In the cluster
images.form: Rounded forms pressed together, sides flattening slightly where they touch, every gap closed between them.

images.label: One-on-one
images.form: Two forms leaning into each other, meeting along one long edge and holding there, with open ground either side.

images.label: Out in the open
images.form: A lone form standing clear with air on every side of it, nothing touching it and nothing in the way.

images.label: In your shell
images.form: A form curled snugly into a sheltering hollow, tucked so close that the hollow's curve and its own meet along their whole length.

images.label: Climbing
images.form: A form part-way up a rising slope, tilted forward into the climb with clear ground above it still to cover.

images.label: Opening
images.form: A closed form unfurling outward, its folds parting to show an inner surface that has not been out before.

images.label: Shedding
images.form: A form shaking off old outer layers, cracked plates falling away from a smoother shape underneath.

images.label: Rooting
images.form: A form settled low and gathering, widening downward into the ground rather than reaching up out of it.

images.label: Coil tighter
images.form: A coil compressed to its limit, every turn shut against the next, storing the load rather than letting any of it out.

images.label: Spread wider
images.form: A form flattened outward under the same load, taking the weight across a wider base and absorbing it.

images.label: The squeeze
images.form: A form pressed hard from both sides at once, bulging where it has nowhere left to give.

images.label: The loop
images.form: A form ringed by identical copies of itself, each ring exactly like the last, closing it in on every side.

images.label: The noise
images.form: A form bombarded by a swarm of small particles striking it from all directions, pitting its surface.

images.label: The wait
images.form: A form suspended over empty ground with nothing beneath it, hanging there with nothing to settle onto.

images.label: First light
images.form: A form rising toward the light, its upper surface already warm where the day has reached it first.

images.label: After dark
images.form: A form with a glowing core held inside a deeper tone, giving its own light because there is none falling on it.

images.label: The pull
images.form: A form leaning hard toward one side, drawn far enough off centre that the lean is the whole shape.

images.label: The plan
images.form: A stepped, ordered form rising in even increments, each level squared to the one below it.

images.label: The gut
images.form: A form twisted from its own centre outward, the turn starting deep inside it and working out to the surface.

images.label: The pause
images.form: A still form standing between two diverging paths, settled on neither, waiting where they part.

steps.question: After a hard day, you reset by:

images.label: Melt
images.form: A form softening and spreading where it stands, its edges going slack and running gently outward.

images.label: Switch off
images.form: A sealed smooth form with no opening anywhere on it, closed over and giving nothing away.

images.label: Shake it off
images.form: A form throwing off fragments in every direction, shedding what it was carrying in one motion.

images.label: Plug in
images.form: A form set close beside a glowing source, its near side already taking the light and warming with it.

images.label: The push
images.form: A form driving another one forward, its weight behind the second and the ground marked where both have moved.

images.label: The hold
images.form: A form bent under a heavy sphere sunk into its upper surface, the deformation visible all around where it takes the weight.

images.label: The soft place
images.form: A concave form opening upward, hollowed to receive whatever is set down in it and shaped by what it has held.

images.label: The answer
images.form: A closed form with a single teal keyhole seam cut into it, the one opening in an otherwise solid shape.

images.label: Hot
images.form: A taut form held under tension in a heated amber tone, the colour itself running warm right through it.

images.label: Cool
images.form: A smooth even form in a cool grey-blue tone, unhurried, holding its temperature whatever is happening around it.

images.label: High
images.form: A solid unbroken enclosure standing right around a form, closed the whole way with no way in.

images.label: Half-open
images.form: A wall with one clear gap left in it, wide enough to pass through and left that way on purpose.

images.label: Down
images.form: An unfolded open form laid flat, its sides dropped outward and its whole inner surface facing up.

images.label: Selective
images.form: A door set into a wall with a teal edge running its whole outline, shut now and clearly made to open.

steps.question: Ten years out, the win is:

images.label: Lit up
images.form: The glowing cracked form, its teal core showing through the surface — still giving light off, and more of it than it started with.

images.label: At peace
images.form: The settled soft form in a warm tone, spread and easy on its base, with nothing left in it that needs bracing.

now_settled.line: Settled, and in no hurry to move.

chapter_climbing.line: Climbing, with ground still above you.

chapter_opening.line: Opening, and showing a side that was in.

chapter_rooting.line: Rooting, and going down before up.

styles.name: The Igniter
styles.blurb: You start things. The room knows what you think before you have finished deciding it, and most of what you have built began as a sentence you said out loud too early.

palette.line: Flare coral is your everyday register, signal amber is what you reach for when you want the room to turn, and cinder ink is the weight that keeps the other two from burning out by Thursday.
talismans: A brass key, in the coat you actually wear
A folding knife — carried, not shown
One notebook small enough to finish
palette.lucky_days: Tuesday and Saturday — the first for starting things, the second for finishing them.

mistake_one.title: You mistake speed for certainty
mistake_one.body: Your momentum reads to you as evidence — the decision came fast, so it feels like it came from somewhere deep. Sometimes it came from nothing but the discomfort of sitting still, and the two are identical from the inside.
mistake_one.fix: Sleep one night on any decision you could explain in under ten seconds.

styles.name: The Keeper
styles.blurb: You hold. Other people plan around you being where you were, and the things you carry are mostly things nobody has thought to thank you for.

palette.line: Moss sage is where you are most yourself, quarry grey is what you wear when you would rather not be read, and field olive is the one that makes a room feel like it has been there a while.
talismans: A river stone, in the pocket you use least
A wooden handle worn smooth by one hand
A key to a door you no longer need to open
palette.lucky_days: Sunday and Wednesday — the first for deciding, the second for saying it.

mistakes.setup: That one is the easiest of the five to admit to. The other four cost more, and the one running your week right now is
mistakes.trigger: the weight you agreed to carry silently,

dna.setup: Steadiness and privacy look like one trait from outside and are two inside, and the seam between them shows
dna.trigger: in the questions you took longest on,

materials.setup: You are the safest person most people know, and the one who lasts with you is the one who

splurge.setup: Your working energy runs long rather than hot, and the month it pays best is

shopping.setup: Most of your next twelve months is steady and two stretches are not, and the first of them lands
shopping.trigger: just after you have taken something else on,

mistake_one.title: You call it patience when it is postponement
mistake_one.body: Waiting is a real strategy and you are genuinely good at it, which is exactly why it hides the other thing — the conversation you have been not-having for months looks identical, from the outside, to one you are wisely timing.
mistake_one.fix: Name a date for the thing you are waiting on. If you cannot, you are not waiting.

styles.name: The Feeler
styles.blurb: You read the room before anybody speaks in it. What you know about the people around you arrived without being told, and you have been acting on it for years.

palette.line: Bright teal is the one people notice, deep teal is where you actually live, and riffle pearl is what keeps the other two from reading as cold.
talismans: A feather kept flat between two pages
A shell small enough to close a hand around
One ring you only take off to swim
palette.lucky_days: Monday and Friday — the first for listening, the second for saying what you heard.

mistakes.setup: That one is the easiest of the five to laugh about. The other four sit lower, and the one taking the most from you now is
mistakes.trigger: the mood you picked up and kept,

dna.setup: Depth and openness pull in opposite directions and you run both at once, and where they meet shows
dna.trigger: in the pictures you chose without thinking,

materials.setup: You know how somebody feels before they do, and the one who lasts with you is the one who

splurge.setup: Your working energy moves in tides rather than hours, and the month it comes back in is
splurge.trigger: the one you would have written off,

shopping.setup: Your next twelve months has two high stretches and one flat one, and the flat one arrives
shopping.trigger: right after the busiest thing you agree to,

mistake_one.title: You take on the room's weather as your own
mistake_one.body: You walk into a tense room and come out tense, and by the evening it has stopped being the room's and become yours. Nobody handed it to you; you picked it up on the way past, which is why you cannot find where it came from.
mistake_one.fix: After any hard room, name out loud whose feeling it was. Out loud — thinking it does not work.

styles.name: The Thinker
styles.blurb: You want to see the shape of it. You will sit with a question longer than is comfortable rather than take the answer that arrived first.

palette.line: Lens violet is the one that makes people ask what you do, paper linen is where you think best, and brass gold is the warmth that stops the other two reading as cold.
talismans: A compass that does not need to be accurate
One good pen, refilled rather than replaced
A magnifier, in a drawer you open weekly
palette.lucky_days: Thursday and Sunday — the first for deciding, the second for changing your mind.

mistakes.setup: That one is the easiest of the five to explain away. The other four are harder, and the one running you this month is
mistakes.trigger: the answer you already have and keep testing,

dna.setup: Distance and depth look like one habit and are two, and the join between them shows
dna.trigger: in the questions you answered instantly,

materials.setup: You are read as cool long before you feel it, and the one who lasts with you is the one who
materials.trigger: keeps asking after you go quiet,

splurge.setup: Your working energy pays in the months you are left alone, and the first of those is
splurge.trigger: not the one you have blocked out,

shopping.setup: Two windows in your next twelve months are worth more than the other ten, and the first opens
shopping.trigger: while you are still preparing for it,

mistake_one.title: You research the thing instead of doing it
mistake_one.body: Understanding a problem feels near-identical to solving it, and you are good enough at the first that you can stay there for months. The tell is that you can describe every option and have not started any.
mistake_one.fix: When you catch yourself on the third source, stop and do the smallest version of the thing instead.
